nodes.label: Migration 010: Fix All Critical Schema Issues
Hierarchical Test Categories
nodes.rationale: Self-referencing parent_id enables unlimited category depth for exam taxonomy (Category -> Sub Category -> Sub Sub Category)

nodes.label: Soft Delete Pattern
nodes.rationale: Standardized is_deleted + deleted_by + deleted_at columns across 7 tables to preserve data while allowing logical deletion

nodes.label: Orphan Record Tracking
nodes.rationale: Added _orphaned and orphaned_at columns to tests and questions tables to track records whose foreign key references have been deleted

nodes.label: Role-Based Access Control
nodes.rationale: permissions + roles + user_roles + role_permissions tables implement RBAC for admin panel with resource:action granularity

nodes.label: Node Engine Architecture
nodes.rationale: Single nodes table with type column and JSONB meta replaces all separate entity tables. Enables unlimited hierarchy depth, no schema migrations, and AI-ready structure with ai_meta column. Evolves through V1 (structure) to V6 (civilization simulation).

nodes.label: AI Question Generation
nodes.rationale: P0 priority feature using OpenRouter API (GPT-4/Claude-3-Sonnet) to generate MCQ questions with 87% time savings. Includes rate limiting, cost tracking, and output validation.

nodes.label: Semantic Search with pgvector
nodes.rationale: P1 feature using pgvector extension and text-embedding-ada-002 for vector similarity search across questions, tests, and study materials

nodes.label: Three-App Monorepo Architecture
nodes.rationale: Monorepo with separate student frontend (port 3000), admin panel (port 3002), and backend API (port 5001). Uses npm workspaces and Turborepo.

nodes.label: Centralized Emoji and Asset Config
nodes.rationale: Shared configuration pattern for emoji mappings and asset URLs across frontend and admin panel to eliminate hardcoded values

nodes.label: Multi-Platform Deployment
nodes.rationale: Frontend and admin panel on Vercel, backend on Railway/Render, PostgreSQL on Supabase, Redis on Upstash

nodes.label: Spaced Repetition Engine
nodes.rationale: Forgetting curve logic calculates revision urgency based on mastery score and time since last attempt. Higher mastery = longer interval between revisions.

nodes.label: Adaptive Test Generation
nodes.rationale: Generates tests weighted by user weak areas. Questions distributed proportionally to (1 - mastery) across topics.
